token_counting: Complete Tool.text without model-added special tokens; reject overflow, never truncate.

generation.method: One offline subagent rewriting descriptions from sanitized source definitions, followed by main-agent review.
generation.constraints: Preserve canonical tool_id, name, origin; no server label, keyword list, schema dump, invented capabilities or credentials. Budget is an upper bound, not a target.

questions_policy: Byte-identical copy of the frozen 400-question dataset; retain intent groups, split, labels and queries.
evaluation_status: Evaluated on the frozen 79-question test split with N=20, M=20, K=5; no parameter selection. Historical mcp_tools scores remain separate.
review_notes: Main agent read all 200 expanded description rows; an independent subagent compared all rows against source description and schema without reading evaluation questions or results.
Clarified Star versus Watch, drag/drop versus clipboard paste, TQL operator-specific field scopes, and aiSearchDocument's conditional omitted-limit behavior.
github/issue_write's source contains a broad issue/pull-request title but methods only clarify Issue writes; no unsupported PR creation capability was added.
limitations: Descriptions are generated offline, not a claim of runtime tool availability.
Public schemas are reconstructed from pinned official README parameter documentation; local licenses remain NOASSERTION.
Expanding descriptions does not prove retrieval improvement.
